libraries.name: @internationalized/date
libraries.note: All 386 tests passed. The suite runs once: CI tests React 16 to canary, not a range of Node versions. The 12 methods on the Calendar interface are counted once, not again on each of its 13 implementations.

libraries.name: Luxon
libraries.note: CI (.github/workflows/test.yml) runs `npm run test` on Node 20, 22, 24 and 25 under one fixed time zone, America/New_York, so executions are 1,222 × 4. The 39 local failures come from the machine: the suite assumes its CI container's local time zone is America/New_York. They do not change the test count. Luxon ships no types, so the API was counted from @types/luxon 3.7.5, which tracks 3.7.x.

libraries.name: date-fns
libraries.note: The Node version in CI is not set explicitly (`node = "latest"`), so the suite counts once. A dedicated time-zone workflow exists, but its scope is unclear and is not counted. The 46 local failures come from the machine: the experimental native-Temporal code path needs a global Temporal that Node does not provide. They do not change the test count. `formatDate` is an alias of `format`, counted once. The 1 method is the function-typed member of the exported Localize type.

libraries.name: Moment.js
libraries.note: 0 tests failed on Node 24. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs `pnpm test` on three Node versions (lts/*, lts/-1, latest), so executions are 3,901 × 3. timezones.yml re-runs 5 test modules, not the full suite, under 6 zones; those partial runs are not counted. The repository holds 191 test files; `locales` counts the 139 of them that test a locale.

libraries.name: Day.js
libraries.note: A single default run is 93 suites and 794 tests. The repository's `test` script first re-runs test/timezone.test.js (6 tests) and test/plugin/timezone.test.js (54 tests) under 6 distinct TZ values (Pacific/Auckland, Europe/London, America/Whitehorse, the system default, Europe/Paris, America/New_York), then runs the full jest suite: 4 × 6 + 4 × 54 + 794 = 1,034 executions. `locales` counts test/locale.test.js plus the 41 files in test/locale/. CI runs `npm test` on a single Node LTS. The API count covers the core and the 37 plugins shipped in the same npm package; core alone is 4 functions and 30 methods. The commit is on the `dev` branch, where `package.json` carries the placeholder version `0.0.0-development`: its `src`, `test` and `types` trees are the same as those of the tag v1.11.23.

libraries.name: Spacetime
libraries.note: 6,086 tests ran: 6,045 passed and 41 failed. All 41 are `dst-off` post-transition assertions in europe/london, europe/ljubljana and atlantic/madeira. CI runs Node 20.x and 26.x, so executions are 6,086 × 2. `locales` counts test/i18n.test.js and test/intl.test.js. `timezones` counts the 8 dedicated time-zone and DST test files that run (dst-north, dst-south, dst-sneak, findTz, informal-tzs, kazakhstan-timezones, swapTz, timezone-name). Four more DST files exist but are disabled by their `.ignore.js` extension and are in no count. 32 of its methods are declared as function-typed members, counted as methods.
